1: // Nebula Escape – simple endless runner
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){console.error('Canvas #game not found');return;}
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   // Audio setup
8:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
9:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
10:   function playBeep(freq, dur) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.type = 'sine';
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     osc.start();
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
21:   }
22:   function playCrash(){playBeep(100,0.4);} // low thump
23:   function playFuel(){playBeep(800,0.1);} // short high beep
24:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
25:   // Starfield background
26:   const stars = [];
27:   const starCount = 100;
28:   for(let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
29:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, r: Math.random() * 2 + 1, s: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5 });
30:   }
31: 
32:   // Player ship
33:   const ship = {x:50, y:height/2, w:30, h:20, dy:0, fuel:100};
34:   const shipSpeed = 3;
35: 
36:   // Obstacles and pickups
37:   const asteroids = [];
38:   const fuels = [];
39:   const spawnAsteroid =()=>{
40:     const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
41:     asteroids.push({x:width, y:Math.random()*(height-size), w:size, h:size, speed:2+Math.random()*3});
42:   };
43:   const spawnFuel =()=>{
44:     const size = 15;
45:     fuels.push({x:width, y:Math.random()*(height-size), w:size, h:size, speed:2});
46:   };
47:   let asteroidTimer=0, fuelTimer=0;
48:   let gameOver=false;
49: 
50:   // Input handling
51:   const keys={};
52:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true;});
53:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});
54: 
55:   function update(){
56:     if(gameOver) return;
57:     // player movement
58:     if(keys['ArrowUp']) ship.dy = -shipSpeed;
59:     else if(keys['ArrowDown']) ship.dy = shipSpeed;
60:     else ship.dy = 0;
61:     ship.y += ship.dy;
62:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height-ship.h, ship.y));
63: 
64:     // fuel consumption
65:     ship.fuel -= 0.05;
66:     if(ship.fuel<=0) endGame();
67: 
68:     // spawn obstacles / fuel
69:     asteroidTimer++; fuelTimer++;
70:     if(asteroidTimer>90) {spawnAsteroid(); asteroidTimer=0;}
71:     if(fuelTimer>300) {spawnFuel(); fuelTimer=0;}
72: 
73:     // move asteroids
74:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
75:       const a=asteroids[i];
76:       a.x -= a.speed;
77:       if(a.x + a.w <0) asteroids.splice(i,1);
78:       else if(collide(ship,a)) {playCrash(); endGame();}
79:     }
80:     // move fuel cells
81:     for(let i=fuels.length-1;i>=0;i--){
82:       const f=fuels[i];
83:       f.x -= f.speed;
84:       if(f.x + f.w <0) fuels.splice(i,1);
85:       else if(collide(ship,f)) {playFuel(); ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel+30); fuels.splice(i,1);}    }
86:     // move stars (parallax)
87:     for(let s of stars){
88:       s.x -= s.s;
89:       if(s.x < 0) {
90:         s.x = width;
91:         s.y = Math.random()*height;
92:       }
93:     }
94:   }
95: 
96:   function collide(r1,r2){
97:     return !(r2.x > r1.x + r1.w ||
98:              r2.x + r2.w < r1.x ||
99:              r2.y > r1.y + r1.h ||
100:              r2.y + r2.h < r1.y);
101:   }
102: 
103:   function draw(){
104:     // gradient background
105:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,width,height);
106:     grad.addColorStop(0,'#000020');
107:     grad.addColorStop(1,'#000040');
108:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
109:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
110:     // stars
111:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
112:     ctx.shadowBlur=2;
113:     ctx.shadowColor='white';
114:     for(let s of stars){
115:       ctx.beginPath();
116:       ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,2*Math.PI);
117:       ctx.fill();
118:     }
119:     ctx.shadowBlur=0;
120:     // ship (triangle with stroke)
121:     ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
122:     ctx.strokeStyle='white';
123:     ctx.lineWidth=2;
124:     ctx.beginPath();
125:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h/2);
126:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
127:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
128:     ctx.closePath();
129:     ctx.fill();
130:     ctx.stroke();
131:     // asteroids (circles)
132:     ctx.fillStyle='gray';
133:     asteroids.forEach(a=> {
134:       ctx.beginPath();
135:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, Math.max(a.w,a.h)/2,0,2*Math.PI);
136:       ctx.fill();
137:     });
138:     // fuel cells (glowing yellow)
139:     ctx.fillStyle='yellow';
140:     ctx.shadowBlur=5;
141:     ctx.shadowColor='yellow';
142:     fuels.forEach(f=> {
143:       ctx.beginPath();
144:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.w/2, f.y + f.h/2, Math.max(f.w,f.h)/2,0,2*Math.PI);
145:       ctx.fill();
146:     });
147:     ctx.shadowBlur=0;
148:     // fuel gauge
149:     ctx.fillStyle='lime';
150:     ctx.fillRect(10,10, ship.fuel*2, 10);
151:     ctx.strokeStyle='black';
152:     ctx.strokeRect(10,10,200,10);
153:     if(gameOver){
154:       ctx.fillStyle='red';
155:       ctx.font='48px sans-serif';
156:       ctx.textAlign='center';
157:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
158:     }
159:   }
160: 
161:   function loop(){
162:     if(!gameOver){
163:       update();
164:     }
165:     draw();
166:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
167:   }
168: 
169:   function endGame(){gameOver=true;}
170: 
171:   loop();
172: })();
